project_type: Rust monorepo (Cargo workspace) with a companion deps repo for extracted tests/benchmarks
build_system: Cargo workspace. hydro repo is the main monorepo; hydro-deps is a separate repo that holds extracted tests and benchmarks with git-based dependencies back to hydro.
test_framework: cargo test / cargo nextest. Benchmarks use criterion.
test_command: cargo test --all-targets (in /projects/sandbox/hydro) -- but INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network means we cannot install deps. Use AST/syntax validation instead.
verification_instructions: 1. Verify benches/ directory is removed from hydro repo. 2. Verify 'benches' is removed from workspace members in hydro/Cargo.toml. 3. Verify Cargo.lock no longer contains the benches package entry. 4. Verify benchmark.yml workflow is removed from hydro. 5. Verify CHANGELOG.md files are created in both repos.
setup_instructions: Rust toolchain 1.90.0 is pinned in rust-toolchain.toml. No special setup needed beyond cargo.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages, pull images, or make external network calls. Use file-level validation (check file contents, verify removals, check TOML syntax) rather than cargo build/test.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits. PRs should follow squash+merge. RELEASING.md has guidance on moving crates (changelog preservation). Since benches is publish=false and version 0.0.0, no release/changelog concerns for the crate itself.
key_patterns: Workspace members listed in root Cargo.toml. hydro-deps uses git dependencies pointing to BigWeaverZeta/hydro.git for dfir_rs and sinktools. The benchmark.yml workflow runs 'cargo bench -p benches'. CI workflow (ci.yml) does not reference benches directly.
directory_structure: hydro/ is the main monorepo with workspace members (dfir_rs, hydro_lang, etc.) and benches/. hydro-deps/ is a companion repo with extracted tests (dfir_rs_tests, hydro_lang_tests, etc.) and already has benches/ copied over with git-based deps.
